note: [UnseenThrottle] phase 1 (docs/143 §6.5) crowd A/B rerun. Why: the 2026-10-30 unseen-throttle-ab-v024 crowd pair was confounded (rare-big-crowd waves ran inside the first counted arm at ~30 it/s, the second arm after remove_sims at ~140 it/s) and the arms were 1-3 min. Here: crowd-steady repro (new repros.json entry: spawns inside the 5-min warm-up slice, then a fixed 300 s wave cycle and no removal, so every slice sees the same crowd and wave phase), 5-min slices (each arm 2 x 5 min), both slice orders, BP + IP. Build: game-copy/ts3native.asi.int129 (0.36.129, newest parked integration build of master) with ts3fixes from the same commit. Heavy tools off (noSamplers; HitchAttr light). Timing: clean machine only. Run time: smoke ~10 min + 4 jobs x ~30 min = ~2 h 10 min. Verdicts: TS3_REPO=<main> node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts unseen-throttle-ab-v2-<date>-bp-ut2-crowd unseen-throttle-ab-v2-<date>-ip-ut2-crowd (offfirst + onfirst pair means: p99/p99.9, max, counts >= 100/300/500/1000/2000 ms per 10 min); node tools/harness/wait-ab.ts <tag> (key 0x85FE10 steering on vs off beyond the docs/136 null); node tools/harness/unseen-report.ts <native.json>; it/s per slice from <tag>-ab.json. Pass: hitch counts not higher on, steering key lower on, it/s on not down more than 2% (docs/143 §8.15 measured ~10% loss from the avoidance skip: confirm or refute under the steady crowd).

smoke.note: Measurement smoke (AGENTS.md): BP 5 min, crowd-steady, --ab unseenthrottle 1-min slices. Pass: both arms in the per-arm split, utMode read back 0 / 1 per slice, utSkipped grows only in on slices, heavy tools off, no crash. A FAIL stops the queue.
